dedupe_keys.name: dataset for optimizing strategic urban waste management using random artificial neural networks a case study of shiraz

description: Babak Rouhi Broujeni publishes a workbook supporting a municipal solid-waste forecasting study in Shiraz, Iran. Zenodo provides Total Data.xlsx under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The deposit says it includes an analytical dataset, variable descriptions, table and figure values, and model inputs and outputs prepared from Shiraz Municipality source data. It can supply a local calibration or comparison case for waste-generation forecasts and collection-capacity scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these Shiraz inputs. A limitation is that the landing page does not give the years, spatial units, waste categories or total observations. The source data have already been prepared by the study authors, so the workbook is not a raw municipal operating feed. The XLSX was not downloaded, and neither variable definitions nor neural-network predictions were independently checked.
